environment.network: none; HTTP requests run on container loopback
environment.production_entrypoint: python -m app.main; eight Waitress threads and scheduler enabled

checks: authentication isolation
login and session cookie
production pages, health and dynamic no-store
asset integrity, gzip, HEAD and ETag/304 through Waitress
SSR, sensitive-page isolation, dynamic gzip, Range, binary and 406
batch edit/conflict, CRUD, sorting, settings, import/export, invalid Bark, renewal and undo

schema:
CREATE TABLE notification_attempts (
                    cycle_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','success','failed')),
                    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at REAL NOT NULL, retry_at REAL NOT NULL,
                    error TEXT
                )
CREATE TABLE renewals (cycle_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE sessions (token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, expires_at REAL NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE settings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 1), value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE state (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE subscriptions (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL,
                    billing_cycle TEXT NOT NULL, payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
                    amount REAL NOT NULL CHECK(amount >= 0), currency TEXT NOT NULL,
                    notify_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(notify_enabled IN (0, 1))
                )
